# Users sub-actions

## Pick a random recent chatter

Picks one random viewer who chatted recently and saves their name in variables. Great for "a random viewer wins" or "shout-out someone" actions.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only pick viewers from this site. All means any site. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Variable name start** | The start of the variable names, without % signs. The default randomUser gives %randomUser% (their name), %randomUserId% and more. Starts as: `randomUser`. |
| **Exclude the triggering user** | Tick so the viewer who started the action cannot be picked. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%randomUser%` | The picked viewer's display name (the start of the name can be changed in the settings) |
| `%randomUserName%` | Their chat name |
| `%randomUserId%` | Their id on their site |
| `%randomUserPlatform%` | The site they are on |
| `%randomUserFound%` | True if someone could be picked |

<small>Type id: `users.addRandomPresentUser`</small>

## Reset first words

Forgets who has already chatted, so the "First words" trigger can welcome everyone again. It also resets by itself when you go live, unless switched off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only forget viewers on this site. All means every site. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%firstWordsReset%` | How many viewers were forgotten |

<small>Type id: `users.resetFirstWords`</small>
